title: Raising a Premium Re-Rating on a Travel Protection Policy
content:
Where a declared particular of the risk on a certificate of the Travel Protection Plans has changed after
issue, the premium is re-rated and the difference is charged to the policyholder as a re-rating line on the
policy's premium record. The re-rating increases the net premium the policyholder has paid for the cover; what
the policyholder can see afterwards is the re-rating standing on their premium record alongside the lines raised
when the certificate was issued.

## When the charge is worked out

The re-rating owed on a correction is worked out only after the certificate carries the declared particulars the
underwriting desk has approved for it.

## The line a re-rating is raised against

A re-rating is raised against the line that carries the base premium of the certificate, because
that is the line the whole premium was rated from, and where the premium record carries no such
line it is raised against the earliest line charged on the policy; a loading line, the line charged
for the issue fee and a line raised to correct another line are never the line a re-rating is
raised against.

## How the write is made

The desk unlocks the agency-side tool `raise_premium_rerating_6e8395e4` and calls it. One call adds a re-rating
line to the policy's premium record: it carries the amount charged, the date it posted and the earlier premium
line it adjusts.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `care_policy_id` | The reference number of the travel protection policy being re-rated, read from the policy record found for the traveller |
| `customer_id` | The traveller reference number of the policyholder charged, read from the traveller profile |
| `source_entry_id` | The reference number of the earlier premium line this re-rating is raised against, read from the premium record of that policy |
| `rerating_amount_usd` | The amount the re-rating charges, given as a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

## What comes back

A plain-text confirmation naming the reference number minted for the re-rating line, the policy and the earlier
line it adjusts, and the amount charged. Receiving that confirmation is what indicates the re-rating has been
raised; nothing else is returned.
